title: 2023 AMC 12A Problem 22
statement: Let \(f\) be the unique function defined on the positive integers such that \[ \sum_{d\mid n} d\cdot f\left(\frac{n}{d}\right)=1 \] for all positive integers \(n,\) where the sum is taken over all positive divisors of \(n.\) What is \(f(2023)?\)

solutions.text:
Setting \(n=1\) gives \(f(1)=1.\) For a prime \(p,\) \(n=p\) gives \(f(p)+p\cdot f(1)=1,\) so \(f(p)=1-p.\) For \(n=p^2,\) \(f(p^2)+p\,f(p)+p^2 f(1)=1\) gives \(f(p^2)=1-p.\)

Since the defining relation is a Dirichlet convolution of multiplicative functions, \(f\) is multiplicative. With \(2023=7\cdot 17^2,\) \[ \begin{gathered} f(2023)=f(7)\cdot f(17^2)\\ {}=(1-7)(1-17)\\ {}=(-6)(-16)\\ {}=96. \end{gathered} \]

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: The relation determines \(f\) recursively; \(f\) turns out to be multiplicative
